priceSnapshot.note: Spot 76,671.8. The freshness guard earned its place again: the sandbox proxy returned an OKX server time of 2026-09-13T17:45:49Z, six hours and forty-nine minutes stale and almost exactly the midday run's own mark, so every number here was re-pulled in-page with cache no-store and the ticker that came back was one second old against server time. The minus 0.77 percent is open24h 77,270.4 against the 76,671.8 mark. That understates the session badly: since the midday mark of 77,349.9 price is down 678.1 points, or 0.88 percent, and from the 21:00Z high of 77,452.1 it has fallen 1,057.2 points in under three hours. The post-midday box is 76,394.9 to 77,452.1, a 1,057.2-point range against a 2,118.69 daily ATR. Midday's 76,559.4 reduce gate did NOT fire on its own terms - the lowest settled hourly close was 76,721.8 - but the wick went 164.5 points through it, and midday's 77,387.4 add gate missed by 38.9 points on a settled close after trading 64.7 points past it on the wick. Both gates were touched and neither was confirmed, which is the whole story of the day.

reduceIf.confirmation: A settled 1H CLOSE below 76,394.9, today's low and the 24h low, 276.9 points under spot. That level is not arbitrary: it is where the 958,020 USD long flush stopped, and it sits directly on top of the 76,400 liquidation bucket that absorbed 427,286 USD across 19 fills - the largest single cluster measured today in either direction. Losing it on a settled close means the magnet has been eaten rather than defended, and the next measured flow below it is only 67,422 USD at 76,300, after which there is nothing until the 76,001.0 floor. Trim further on that close, not on a wick - the wick has already been through 76,394.9 once tonight and bought back.

addIf.confirmation: A settled 1H CLOSE above 77,023.5, the 1Dutc EMA20, 351.7 points above spot. This is the level the whole day has been fought over. It broke at 08:00Z, was reclaimed through the afternoon squeeze, and has now been lost again on the 22:00Z break - price sits 351.7 points beneath it and below every single 15m, 1H and 4H average. A settled hourly close back above the daily average is the minimum evidence that tonight's break was another liquidity event rather than a trend, and it is the only thing that would justify putting the trimmed spot back on.

decisionBox.changed: Bias turns from midday's range-with-a-bullish-tilt to range-with-a-BEARISH-tilt, and position flips from ADD to REDUCE. Midday's thesis was that the reclaim of the 1Dutc EMA20 had been confirmed; that thesis is dead. Price failed at 77,452.1 on the 21:00Z bar, 64.7 points through the 77,387.4 add trigger but unable to close there, then broke 1,057.2 points to 76,394.9 with 958,020 USD of longs force-sold - the third flush of the day and the biggest of the three. Every average midday listed as reclaimed has been lost again: the 1H EMA20 at 77,105.8, the 1H EMA50 at 77,218.3, the 4H EMA20 at 77,332.5 and the 1Dutc EMA20 at 77,023.5. The stop moves DOWN from midday's 76,480.0 to 76,280.0, beneath both the 76,394.9 low and the 76,300 shelf, because a stop sitting inside the largest liquidation bucket on the tape is a donation. Confidence falls to 5.25: the structure is clearly worse, but 15m RSI at 26.02 and open interest DOWN 1.48 percent say the leverage has already been cleared out, and that is exactly the condition that produced this afternoon's 790-point squeeze.

overnightRisk: The next report is roughly 02:00 COT and the gap is the dangerous part of the day, tonight more than usual. Four specific things. FIRST, the magnet is below and it is close: the 76,400 bucket sits 271.8 points under spot and it has already taken 427,286 USD across 19 fills, the largest cluster measured in either direction today. Beneath it the tape thins fast - 67,422 USD at 76,300 and then NO measured flow at all down to the 76,001.0 floor, a 299-point air pocket into the 11 September low. That is the shape that turns a 300-point drift into a 700-point candle, and it is why the resting stop at 76,280.0 is recommended rather than optional. SECOND, the clock: Asia cash opens within the hour and Monday is the first session since 11 September in which ETF creations can settle, so the four-day minus 462.7 million streak either extends or breaks with no warning to a book that has been trading on leverage alone all weekend. THIRD, positioning is still one-way long into a falling tape - the account-level long/short ratio has gone 1.67, 1.68, 1.70, 1.72 across the day's four marks and funding is still positive at plus 0.0000404718, so the crowd has been adding longs through three consecutive flushes. FOURTH, and cutting the other way, open interest FELL 32,048,934 USD or 1.48 percent since midday, the first decline of the day. Leverage was removed rather than rebuilt for the first time in four sessions, and 15m RSI at 26.02 is the most oversold reading of the sequence. A thin book that has just been cleaned can squeeze as violently as it can break - this afternoon it ran 790.5 points off an identical setup in the opposite direction. Size for a two-way gap, not a one-way one.

liquidation.note: 427,286 USD across only 19 fills - the largest bucket on the tape and, at roughly 22,500 USD per fill, by far the biggest average clip of the night. Every one of them a LONG liquidation. Size per fill is the tell: this was not a drizzle of small stops, it was a handful of leveraged longs being force-sold in size into a book that had nothing under it. It brackets today's 76,394.9 low exactly, so this is the level that stopped the break, and it is the single most important number overnight.

308,238 USD across 35 fills, all long-side, and spot sits just 71.8 points above the top of it. This is the shelf the break went through on the way down rather than where it ended, which makes it the first thing to fail again if the tape rolls over - there is no reason for the same longs to defend a level that already stopped them out once.

155,075 USD across 28 fills, all long-side. Smaller clips than the 76,400 cluster, and it coincides with the 76,500.0 low set at 08:00Z this morning - a level that has now been tested twice in one day and held both times on a closing basis. Structural support rather than fuel.

67,422 USD across 14 fills - and the smallness is the point. This is the LAST measured liquidation flow beneath the low. Below 76,300 the tape recorded nothing at all down to the 76,001.0 floor, which is where the overnight air pocket lives and why the resting stop is placed at 76,280.0, above the hole rather than inside it.

8,089 USD across 2 fills, the only short-side flow in the entire 100-fill window and 0.8 percent of total forced volume. There is essentially no short fuel overhead. Whatever carries price back to the 1Dutc EMA20 at 77,023.5 will have to be real buying, because there are no trapped shorts left up there to squeeze.

liquidityMagnet.note: Measured realized liquidations, not a forward resting-order heatmap - these mark fuel already spent, and tonight that distinction points one way. The pull is DOWN and it is not close. 958,020 USD of the 966,609 USD total was long-side, 99.1 percent, stacked in four consecutive buckets from 76,600 down to 76,300, all of them BELOW spot. Above spot the tape recorded 8,589 USD in total. The nearestAbove of 77,000 is therefore a technicality rather than a magnet - it is two fills and 8,089 USD - while the nearestBelow at 76,600 sits 71.8 points under the mark with 308,238 USD behind it and the 427,286 USD cluster 200 points beneath that. The one honest counterweight: open interest fell 1.48 percent over the same window, so this fuel was genuinely burned rather than rolled, and a burned book is a lighter book in both directions.

etfFlows.note: Farside Investors US spot Bitcoin ETF tape, re-read row by row at 2026-09-13T19:32 COT rather than carried from midday. The last settled row is still Friday 11 September and the page itself stamps the current date as 13 September, so no new row is mechanically possible before Monday - creations and redemptions do not process at the weekend. The negative streak stands at FOUR, unchanged: 08 Sep minus 46.6, 09 Sep minus 120.2, 10 Sep minus 282.7, 11 Sep minus 13.2, totalling minus 462.7 million. The 11 September composition re-confirmed: IBIT minus 19.2, HODL plus 2.2, MSBT plus 3.8, every other fund flat. The relevance tonight is the timing rather than the number. All three of today's flushes - 739,902 USD of longs this morning, 704,876 USD of shorts this afternoon, 958,020 USD of longs tonight, about 2.4 million USD in total - happened with zero spot ETF flow on either side of them. Monday is the first session in which that can change, and it changes without warning.

liquidations.note: Measured and FRESH - 100 fills spanning 22:56:20Z to 00:33:45Z, the newest 2 minutes before the mark, across a 76,342.8 to 77,052.6 band that brackets spot, so this is live tape and not the stale month-old cache the OKX proxy sometimes serves. The composition is the most lopsided of the three flushes today: 958,020 USD of LONG liquidations against 8,589 USD of shorts, 99.1 percent long-side. Set against this morning's 739,902 USD of longs and this afternoon's 704,876 USD of shorts, the day has force-closed roughly 2.4 million USD across both sides of the book in fourteen hours. The positioning read finally changes tonight, and in a way that cuts both ways. Open interest is 2,138,617,139.44 USD, DOWN 32,048,934 or 1.48 percent from midday's 2,170,666,073.28 - the FIRST decline in four sessions, after two consecutive sessions in which positions were rebuilt faster than they were liquidated. Funding has fallen to plus 0.0000404718, roughly 0.0040 percent, from midday's plus 0.0000939551, so longs are paying materially less than they were six hours ago. Those two together say leverage was genuinely removed rather than rolled. Against that, the account-level long/short ratio is 1.72, up again from 1.70 at midday, 1.68 at morning and 1.67 at midnight - the crowd that is left is MORE long than at any point today, having sat through three flushes. A lighter book that is still one-way long is the definition of a two-way gap.

Both of today's midday gates were touched on the wick and neither confirmed on a settled close - the reduce missed by 162.4 points on closes after trading 164.5 points through on the wick, the add missed by 38.9 points on closes after trading 64.7 points through. Discretionary calls stand at 4 green of the last 5 before tonight; midday's ADD is the one that broke the run.
calibration.note: Midday's 76,559.4 reduce gate did NOT fire on its own terms. It required a settled 1H close and the lowest settled close after the mark was 76,721.8 on the 22:00Z bar, 162.4 points short; the 23:00Z bar closed 76,836.0. The wick is the caveat and it is a large one - the live 00:15Z candle traded to 76,394.9, a full 164.5 points THROUGH the gate, so a trader reading wicks rather than closes was taken out. The 77,387.4 add gate also did not fire: best settled hourly close 77,348.5 on the 20:00Z bar, short by 38.9 points, after the 21:00Z bar printed 77,452.1 and traded 64.7 points past the level without holding it. The 76,001.0 invalidation was never approached, the low holding 393.9 points above it. The recommended resting stop at 76,480.0 WOULD have filled tonight - the low cleared it by 85.1 points - which is the first time in ten sessions that the stop decision cost anything, and the first time recommending one was right. Discretionary: midday ADDED an 8.00 USDT spot tranche at 77,342.2 on a confirmed reclaim. Spot marks 76,671.8, so that tranche is 670.4 points and 0.87 percent OFFSIDE, roughly minus 0.07 USDT, and the spot core it was lowering is worse off too. Hence false. What midday got wrong was not the reclaim - the reclaim was real and it held for five settled hourly closes - but the assumption that a reclaim built entirely on 704,876 USD of short liquidations, with open interest UP 0.98 percent and the long/short ratio climbing to 1.70, had anything underneath it. It named that counterweight explicitly and then sized into the trade anyway.
